strategy.positioning: Done-for-you professional websites for Swedish small businesses; do not compete for DIY or AI website-builder traffic.
strategy.runMode: Run sequentially after the Leadmap test, not at the same time, so the same small budget is not split across two learning campaigns.
strategy.bidRule: Start at 15 SEK. Raise by at most 20% after 3 full days only if the campaign receives fewer than 5 impressions per day. Never exceed 20 SEK during the test.
strategy.budgetRule: Use a campaign total budget so billed spend cannot exceed 750 SEK. Do not use an average daily budget for this test.

descriptions: Professionell företagssida från 2 900 kr. Fast pris, mobilanpassning och kontaktformulär.
Se ett designförslag inom 72 timmar. Verifieringen kostar 499 kr och är återbetalningsbar.
Välj ett tydligt paket och få en färdig hemsida inom 7–14 dagar med personlig service.
Se kundprojekt, paket och priser innan du bestämmer dig. Tydliga villkor före köp.

trackingRequirements: Install the Google tag only after consent and verify it with Tag Assistant.
Fire WIZARD_COMPLETE only after a complete concept request has been stored successfully.
Fire PAYMENT_SUCCESS only from a verified payment-success event, not a button click.
Preserve gclid and UTM values through the form and Stripe flow.

launchGates: The landing page conspicuously discloses the refundable 499 SEK verification payment next to every design-concept CTA.
Claims such as 50+ customers, booking increases, scarcity, testimonials, and turnaround times have retained evidence; otherwise remove them from the paid landing page.
Google Ads conversion tracking and EEA consent signals are tested in production.
All links, forms, mobile layouts, payment cancellation, and payment success paths work in production.
Advertiser verification is completed if Google requests it.
stopRules: Pause immediately if tracking, the form, Stripe, or the landing page breaks.
Review search terms daily and add irrelevant queries as negatives before more spend.
Pause a keyword after 150 SEK with no wizard start.
Pause the campaign at 375 SEK with no completed concept request.
Stop at 750 SEK regardless of learning status.
Do not scale until at least one completed request is manually verified as a real Swedish business lead.
